text:
marta: Heads up — noticed a short blip of dropped connections from the ingress to the backend around 10:40-10:45 UTC (lots of "connection reset by peer" in logs). Can someone point me at the best dashboards/queries to pull 5 sample request IDs and traces? I want to attach examples to a follow-up ticket.

sam: Start with the ingress error-rate dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/ingress/errors?orgId=1&var-service=ingress-gw :eyes:  For traces use Jaeger search: https://jaeger.internal/search?service=ingress-gw . Logs are in Loki/Splunk — quick Loki example: 
```
{job="ingress"} |= "connection reset by peer" | json | sort by _time desc | limit 50
```

marta: I don't have access to run Jaeger queries. Could someone with perms grab 5 request ids between 10:40-10:45 and paste them here?

infra-bot: @marta I can run a quick sample job, kicking off a trace collection now — will post IDs in this thread when ready.

kai: grabbed 4 samples from the Loki window, looks like the backend started sending RSTs after a short period of high backend latency. sample request ids: abc123, def456, ghi789, jkl012. Also saw backend.p95 spike to ~480ms at 10:41.

olivia: route-level heatmap link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/route/heatmap-latency — also check the "inflight connections" panel on the dedicated-gpu / pool dashboard if you suspect connection limits.

ryan: if it's connection resets check upstream (k8s) for pod churn or liveness kills: 
```
kubectl -n ingress get pods -o wide --sort-by=.status.startTime
kubectl -n ingress logs <pod> --since=15m | grep -i reset
```

marta: tagging @oncall — can you monitor this for 15m and escalate if 5xx >= 3% for more than 5m? Right now it's ~0.6% so low.

oncall: @marta will shadow for 15m. My quick checklist: 1) collect the 5 traces 2) check gateway CPU and ephemeral connection count 3) inspect k8s events for OOM/KILL 4) see if any deploys happened at 10:35-10:45. Ping me if it creeps above 1.5%.

sam: handy trace filter to paste into Jaeger or our trace UI: 
```
span.tags.http.status_code >= 500 and span.duration > 2000000
```

marta: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll add the sample ids to the ticket with links to the dashboards and the trace query. :thumbsup:
